name: plugin-compliance-reviewer
description: Assess an agent plugin against a university IT safety and governance baseline and produce an advisory change list, approval gates, and remediation evidence.

interface.longDescription: Reviews plugins for university security, privacy, safety, education, and compliance readiness. Produces plain-language findings and a prioritized change list; it does not modify plugins or certify them.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review the attached plugin against the university IT compliance baseline. Separate verified facts, developer claims, unknowns, and findings, then give me approval gates and concrete remediation evidence.
